title: Bebop not danceable; Latin and Rock-and-Roll
summary: Bebop was not danceable, so Latin and Rock-and-Roll came into vogue.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: When you take... The thing is, the advent of Rock-and-Roll came to be during the era when Bebop and all those fast rhythms were not danceable. It's not like the Big Band Era, where you can dance to it. You'd grab a girl, and you would say, 'Well, let me get into the act.' Well, now, sitting down and listening to musicians run up and down an instrument like that wasn't... I mean, it was kind of monotonous for an audience. So therefore, to dance... I mean, the Latin music came into vogue because people can dance to it!

Now, the reason the Rock-and-Roll came into being, I think, is because you can dance to it. And if you're playing Latin, you damn near come close to...and playing the Latin beats... They call it Latin beats; I will say the Afro beats. The Latin beat is to try to get the melody into it. That's the European culture in it, you know. But it began with Rhumba, then the next year the... All the Latin dance rhythms became popular. You can dance to it.
